stem: Which sentence best shows Chelsea’s problem in the story?

options.label: F
options.text: My dad always asks lots of questions.

options.label: G
options.text: I didn’t want to hurt his feelings, but I didn’t want to go through another school year as a Chowderhead, either.

options.label: H
options.text: Two days later I headed to my new school for the first day of class.

options.label: J
options.text: But there were two kids, twin brothers, who didn’t seem to talk to anyone but each other.
